Kitchen remodel retaining flooring and appliances

Remodel a 200 SF kitchen in Boise, Idaho. Supply and install 18 LF base cabinets, 12 LF wall cabinets, zero tall cabinets, 45 SF quartz countertop, 30 SF tile backsplash, one sink and one faucet. Mid-range painted shaker cabinets with plywood boxes and soft-close hardware. Remove and dispose of existing cabinets, counters, backsplash, sink and faucet. Reconnect plumbing at existing locations. Existing owner appliances remain and are not replaced; detach and reset only as needed. Existing flooring remains untouched; no flooring supply or installation. No structural changes, electrical upgrades, wall painting or HVAC work. Include normal consumables, protection and cleanup. Ground-floor standard access, normal schedule. Exclude permit fees, design, concealed damage and all other rooms.
